title: Web UI search context memory faces

context.summary: Add supported Web UI surfaces for unified search, context preview, manual memory creation, source-backed memory display and face identity operations.
context.background: TASK-126 added the UI foundation and TASK-127 added document pipeline operations. The next public-ready UI scope is search/context/memory/faces over the HTTP API.

in: Extend the UI API client with /v1/search, /v1/context/build, /v1/memories and /v1/faces calls.
Add a Search workspace tab with unified search query, target selection, simple metadata filter and source-ref results.
Add context preview controls and context block display.
Add manual memory creation with required source refs and source-backed memory search display.
Add face identity list, observation list, rename and merge controls using HTTP API calls.
Align memory route source-ref schema with runtime source-ref types returned by search/context/faces.
Add UI insights validation and include it in pnpm check.
Update README, API docs, UI docs, support matrix, repository status and changelog.
out: Runtime settings and diagnostics UI, which is TASK-129.
Docker image/service and installer routing integration, which is TASK-130.
Playwright E2E acceptance, which is TASK-131.
New search, memory, context or face backend algorithms.

acceptance_criteria: The UI can call unified search through POST /v1/search and show hits with source refs and source positions.
The UI can build context through POST /v1/context/build and show context blocks with token debug data.
The UI can create manual source-backed memories through POST /v1/memories and list memory search results with source refs.
The UI can list face identities and observations, rename identities and merge identities through HTTP API calls.
Memory route source-ref schema accepts artifact, processing_run, face_identity and face_observation refs used by current evidence surfaces.
pnpm check includes an insights workspace validator, and docs describe the new supported UI surface.

manual_checks: Open the UI locally and confirm the Search tab renders without browser console errors when the API is unavailable.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
